sugar.title: Hidden Sugar Detected
sugar.short_message: This product contains free sugars or fast-absorbing carbohydrates, even if 'sugar' doesn't appear on the label.
sugar.what_detected: Ingredients classified as free sugars by WHO. See BOTIA Note below for details.
sugar.why_it_matters: WHO and EFSA link free sugar intake to weight gain, dental disease, and metabolic risk. No safe threshold has been identified.
sugar.what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA signals presence only — not quantity, not dietary impact.
sugar.source_note: WHO (2015) · EFSA (2022) · Learn more at botia-safefood.com

sweetener.title: Sweetener Detected
sweetener.short_message: This product contains non-sugar sweeteners. They add sweetness without calories, but their long-term effects are under review.
sweetener.what_detected: Ingredients classified as non-sugar sweeteners (NSS). See BOTIA Note below for details.
sweetener.why_it_matters: WHO advises against using NSS for weight control. Long-term use has been associated with increased risk of type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and mortality.
sweetener.what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA signals presence only — not quantity, not individual health impact.
sweetener.source_note: WHO Guideline: Use of non-sugar sweeteners (2023) · Learn more at botia-safefood.com

texture.title: Texture Modifier Detected
texture.short_message: This product contains thickeners, stabilisers, or emulsifiers used to modify its consistency and structure.
texture.what_detected: Ingredients classified as texture modifiers. See BOTIA Note below for details.
texture.why_it_matters: These additives serve an industrial function absent in minimally processed foods. Their presence is a marker of ultra-processed food (NOVA, FAO/WHO).
texture.what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA signals presence only — not quantity, not individual health impact.
texture.source_note: NOVA Classification System (FAO, 2019) · Learn more at botia-safefood.com

flavor.title: Flavour Intensifier Detected
flavor.short_message: This product contains ingredients designed to intensify taste rather than add natural flavour.
flavor.what_detected: Ingredients classified as flavour enhancers or artificial flavourings. See BOTIA Note below for details.
flavor.why_it_matters: Flavour intensifiers are added when base ingredients lack natural taste. Their presence is a marker of ultra-processed food (NOVA, FAO/WHO).
flavor.what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA signals presence only — not quantity, not individual health impact.
flavor.source_note: NOVA Classification System (FAO, 2019) · Learn more at botia-safefood.com

enumbers.title: E-Code Additives Detected
enumbers.short_message: This product contains E-coded additives — the EU system for identifying authorised food additives.
enumbers.what_detected: One or more E-code additives identified. See BOTIA Note below for details.
enumbers.why_it_matters: E-codes signal ingredients beyond basic food components. Their presence is a marker of ultra-processed food (NOVA, FAO/WHO). Some E-codes are also flagged in other BOTIA alert categories.
enumbers.what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA signals presence only. E-codes are regulated and authorised in the EU — not quantity, not individual health impact.
enumbers.source_note: EU Regulation 1333/2008 · NOVA Classification System (FAO, 2019) · Learn more at botia-safefood.com
